## Checklist

- [ ] PR title and every commit follow the [commit format](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages): `type(scope): summary` plus a short bullet body starting with `- Issue:`, `- Feature:` or `- Context:`
- [ ] `npm run format:check` and `npm run lint` pass
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] UI changes include before and after screenshots
- [ ] No API keys, `.env` contents or personal data are included
- [ ] Docs (README, Help page) are updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to its contributor licence terms
